ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a 12-volt battery feeding a circuit through a 50 Ω resistor. A component labeled zener diode is connected at the output side near the motor connection, and the motor is the load connected to that output node. Reasoning: Following the assigned method, first assume the 5 V zener is regulating. The current through the 50 Ω resistor would be Iseries = (12 V - 5 V) / 50 Ω = 7 V / 50 Ω = 0.14 A = 140 mA. With Imotor = 150 mA, KCL gives Izener = Iseries - Imotor = 140 mA - 150 mA = -10 mA. A negative zener current is not physically possible, so the zener is off. Therefore Izener = 0 and Pzener = 5 V × 0 = 0 mW.
